issue.title: test_repo_project_memory_notes_match_generator_output is promoted by the flake gate on dirty-tree records the attribution filter does not catch

task_type_fields.evidence:
Promoted by `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` as a reproducible flake over the durable host record store, on 2 gate-eligible (<=5-failure) full-run records, both from other workspaces on 2026-08-25:

- 20260825T202053Z-4fcd56796af0 (dirty tree, 3 failures)
- 20260825T205627Z-1282c7a8c7ff (dirty tree, 5 failures)

PASSES SERIALLY on master f56cf4333: `.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q -p no:randomly tests/main/test_init_memory_committed_drift.py::test_repo_project_memory_notes_match_generator_output` gives `passed` in 0.31s, and `sase init memory --check` exits 0 on this tree (a7478bdab regenerated the shims).

LIKELY ROOT CAUSE, stated as a hypothesis for the worker rather than a finding: this node compares the committed memory notes against live generator output, so any workspace mid-edit on `sase/memory/**` or on the generator templates fails it for reasons that have nothing to do with the tree under test. Both records above are `tree_dirty=True`. The gate has a dirty-tree attribution filter (`_is_attributable_dirty_failure`) that already excludes 103 such failures, but it only fires when a changed file sits inside the failing audit's own scanned source root, and it did not fire here.

So the fix is probably one of two things, and the worker should decide which:
1. Make the node skip or degrade when the tree is dirty in the inputs it audits, the way other source-audit tests do; or
2. Widen the gate's dirty-tree attribution so a memory/template edit is attributed to this audit.

Reported by epic sase-tt's land agent (sase-tt.land) while triaging the flake gate before closing sase-tt. Not caused by that epic -- the four memory-shim PROPOSED FOLLOW-UPs sase-tt raised were resolved on master by a7478bdab, and both records above are other workspaces' dirty trees.

payload.description: Also a disagreement between committed memory notes and generator output surfacing as a red gate; that task's root cause may explain or overlap this node's dirty-tree failures.

evidence.note: Independent reproduction from cross-project bead-show verification on 2026-08-28: `just check-full` passed the full non-visual test-cost lane, then failed only `just selection-health --fail-on-new-flake` because `tests/ace/tui/artifacts_contract/test_no_ref_prefix_dispatch.py::test_behavioral_modules_do_not_dispatch_on_ref_prefix` is now over the flake baseline. Exact search found no node-specific task. Historical gate records for this node are all dirty-tree full runs from unrelated ACE TUI/link-rail/artifact-link work: 20260827T020035Z-72abf3729015-1336267, 20260827T032503Z-48e019af82f2-2699835, and 20260828T132946Z-de491c710dda-1022801. The exact node passes in this workspace with `.venv/bin/pytest tests/ace/tui/artifacts_contract/test_no_ref_prefix_dispatch.py::test_behavioral_modules_do_not_dispatch_on_ref_prefix` (1 passed). This is another source-audit dirty-tree attribution miss, not caused by the bead-show diff.
